ready.feedback_bad: Stance is unstable — plant the back foot and stay balanced.
ready.ideal: Feet set, tossing arm free, balanced platform.

unit_turn.feedback_good: Good coil into the trophy position.
unit_turn.feedback_bad: Not enough shoulder turn into the trophy pose.
unit_turn.ideal: Deep coil with chin over front shoulder.

takeback.feedback_good: Racquet on edge into the backscratch.
takeback.feedback_bad: Racquet path into the backscratch is rushed.
takeback.ideal: Racquet drops behind the head with elbow up.

racquet_drop.feedback_bad: Shallow drop — let the racquet head fall further behind the back.
racquet_drop.ideal: Racquet head well below the shoulders.

acceleration.feedback_bad: Arm is casting — drive up through the ball from the legs.
acceleration.ideal: Legs drive first, arm follows up and out.

contact.feedback_bad: Contact is too low — toss and reach higher.
contact.ideal: Full extension at contact above the head.

extension.feedback_good: Pronation and extension through the ball.
extension.feedback_bad: Arm stops at contact — extend and pronate through.
extension.ideal: Reach up and across after contact.

finish.feedback_good: Balanced landing on the front foot.
finish.feedback_bad: Falling off to the side — land balanced inside the court.
finish.ideal: Front-foot landing, racquet finishes past the hip.
